Exact canonical queried table definitions and all their original indexes are extracted from the recorded schema; only these four tables are materialized; foreign keys remain OFF because parent files are not queried. No writes occur during paired query timing.

All old/candidate results preserve the same global sorted distinct cap output in these cases. This is not a replacement for the broader original semantic tests.

Twenty observations are a bounded local design check, not an N30 registered study or confidence-interval/performance gate. Ratios cannot be applied to original whole-build wall time or the 20% acceptance gate.
